System Highlights

45° maxscrew angulation
Dual-threadcortical/cancellous
One-step locktactile + visual confirm
i

Before the list — AO Modular Handles ×2 · Screw/Locking Driver T8 ×2 · Straight & Angled Awl (9mm×1.7mm, 40°) · Drill Guide + AO Drills (12/14/15mm×1.7mm) · Interbody Inserter ×2 · Tamp · Impaction/Extraction Mallet · Counter Torque Handle. Long-shaft screwdrivers set up on ratchet handles.

1

Patient Positioning

Supine, neutral sagittal position on a radiolucent table. Support the neck with a cushion.

2

Exposure & Distraction

Standard anterior exposure; confirm level via fluoroscopy. Perform segmental distraction — essential for restoring disc height and access to the intervertebral space.

3

Endplate Preparation

Clear the cartilaginous endplate to bleeding bone with osteotomes, scrapers, curettes or rasps.

Excessive preparation may weaken the endplates and risks subsidence.
4

Interbody Sizing

Sequentially insert Trials (71-TN-7xxx) to determine footprint, height and 7° lordosis. Trial should sit securely between endplates — confirm on fluoroscopy. Rasps (71-RS-7xxx) may further prepare the endplate or help size.

All trials and rasps share the exact dimensions of the interbody they represent.
5

Interbody Insertion

Rotate the Inserter's gold knob counterclockwise to open the distal tip. Position it onto the sides of the chosen interbody and rotate the gold knob clockwise to secure.

Pack bone graft into the central window, then insert until the plate is flush with the anterior vertebral bodies. Disengage the Inserter (knob CCW) and finish seating with the Tamp (37-IN-0050) if required. Confirm on fluoroscopy.

Do not overtighten the Inserter to the interbody.
6

Screw Hole Preparation

Awl — Straight (71-IN-0010) or Angled (71-IN-0020), 9mm×1.7mm, 40°. Seat fully — press until bottomed out.

Drill — attach the desired AO Drill (71-SP-02xx, 12/14/15mm×1.7mm) or Angled Drill (71-IN-0410) to the Modular Handle. Seat the Drill Guide in the screw hole — this gives a positive stop preventing over-drilling. Angled Drill is not compatible with the Drill Guide; thread on the Counter Torque (71-IN-0407) for control instead.

Trajectory and depth should be confirmed by fluoroscopy for the anatomy.
7

Screw Insertion

Attach the Straight (37-IN-0060) or Angled (71-IN-0400) Driver to the Modular Handle. Seat the driver tip fully into the T8 hexalobe before driving. Insert and firmly seat both bone screws into the interbody.

Screws must be completely seated in the interbody so the locking mechanism can engage — confirm visually and fluoroscopically.
8

Locking Mechanism

Seat the Driver (37-IN-0060) in-line into the locking mechanism and rotate 90° clockwise until it stops to lock both seated screws — no separate locking cover.

Do not rotate the locking mechanism more than once — this weakens it. Confirm visually and fluoroscopically before closure.
9

Closure

Standard closure technique.

R

Implant Removal

Seat the Driver (37-IN-0060) in-line into the locking mechanism and rotate counterclockwise until the screws release. Fully seat the driver into each screw hexalobe and turn counterclockwise to remove both bone screws.

Re-attach the Inserter to the sides of the interbody, thread on the Extraction Mallet (37-IN-0084), and remove the construct from the disc space.

Set 71-BK-0100

3 trays
Tray 1 — Implants, Trials & Handles. 14×12mm & 16×14mm interbodies (7 heights each), 8 trials (14×12 & 16×14, paired heights, 7°), 2 AO Modular Handles, 2 Screw/Locking Drivers T8.
Tray 2 — Bone Screws & Drilling. Screw caddy (3.5/4.0mm self-drill & self-tap, 12–17mm), Drill Guide, 3× AO Straight Drills, Straight & Angled Awl, 2× Interbody Inserters, Angled Driver, Angled Drill, Counter Torque Handle.
Tray 3 — Tamp, Mallet & Rasps. Tamp (37-IN-0050), Impaction/Extraction Mallet (37-IN-0084), full rasp rack 71-RS-74xx / 71-RS-76xx (14×12 & 16×14, paired heights, 7°).

Surgeon Preferences

tap to expand in theatre
A

Atallah / Registrars

Dakota ACDF · anterior cervical
  • DistractionLikes to tamp into the disc space to achieve greater distraction before final sizing.
  • Sizing noteTake this into account when measuring AP (disc height) distance — the tamped distraction can make the space read larger than it will settle.
  • Cage sizeDiscuss cage height with the surgeon before opening an implant — confirm trial fit and intended height together rather than opening on the initial trial read.
I

Ibbett

Dakota ACDF · anterior cervical
  • Screw lengthConservative choice — 15mm maximum. Check with her before going longer.
  • Cage fitDoesn't want the cage distracted far back toward the spinal canal — aim for a comfortable fit, not maximal distraction.
  • Default sizeStart trial at 16×14. She'll ask to size up further if there's clearly room at trial.
